title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 18 FEBRUARY 2026 Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 17 February 2026 Showery condition is expected to enhance in Northern, North-central, Central, Uva and Eastern provinces in next few days from today (17 February). Showers will occur at times in Northern, North-central, Central, Uva and Eastern provinces and in Hambantota district. Heavy falls about 100 mm are likely at some places in Eastern, Uva and North-central provinces and in Matale and Nuwara-Eliya districts. Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places elsewhere after 1.00 p.m. Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Central and Sabaragamuwa provinces and in Galle and Matara districts during the early hours of the morning. The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages caused by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershower
